announcement.text: First time at Imperium? Get 15% off with your Aloha welcome and a free assessment

promos.title: Aloha Welcome
promos.text: 15% off your first treatment and a free assessment before you start. No obligation.

promos.title: Ohana: bring your people
promos.text: Come with a friend or family member who's new to us and you'll each get 20% off.

promos.title: Imperium Mornings
promos.text: Tuesday to Thursday, 10:00 to 13:00, 10% off manicures, pedicures, massages and facials. Ideal if you work from home, study or work afternoon shifts.
promos.validity: Tuesday to Thursday, 10:00 to 13:00, excluding public holidays

promos.title: Your month, your gift
promos.text: During your birthday month we'll treat you to an extra at your appointment (a mask, a brow tint or 10 extra minutes of massage). Just let us know when you book.
promos.validity: Your birthday month, once a year

promos.title: Start laser now and be summer-ready
promos.text: Autumn and winter are the best time to start: less sun, less risk of pigmentation and time to complete several sessions. Free patch test.

promos.title: Christmas gift cards
promos.text: Give a treatment or a pack with a personalised gift card. Valid for 6 months, with the option to choose the treatment later.

loyalty.name: Crown Club
loyalty.description: The more you look after yourself, the more we reward you. With our loyalty card every session counts and, once it is complete, it turns into exclusive discounts and offers for club members.

leadMagnet.title: Free skin diagnosis
leadMagnet.text: In 20 minutes we analyse your skin type, pigmentation, pores or stretch marks and give you a clear plan with options and prices in writing. You decide whether to go ahead, no obligation.

faqGeneral.q: How can I book an appointment?
faqGeneral.a: By WhatsApp, by phone, with the online booking button on the website or by popping into the centre. We'll confirm your appointment by message.

faqGeneral.q: What if I can't make my appointment?
faqGeneral.a: Let us know at least 24 hours in advance and we'll rearrange it free of charge. If you repeatedly don't show up or cancel at shorter notice, we may ask for a deposit for future bookings, because someone else could have used that slot.

faqGeneral.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqGeneral.a: Cash, card and Bizum. Packs and packages are paid for when you start the treatment; ask us if you'd prefer to pay in two instalments.

faqGeneral.q: It's my first time. How does it work?
faqGeneral.a: Arrive 5 minutes early to fill in a short form. We'll talk about what you're looking for, assess the area or your skin and explain the treatment, the number of sessions and the price before we start. Plus, you get 15% off with your Aloha welcome.

Yes, with treatments suitable for their age (manicures, pedicures, brows, cleansing facials, waxing…). Under-16s must be accompanied, and 16- and 17-year-olds need signed permission from a parent or guardian. Some treatments, such as laser, micropuncture or Dermapen, require a specific assessment.

Packages and packs are valid for 12 months from purchase, which is plenty of time to complete the sessions at the recommended frequency. They're personal, but you can ask us if you need to transfer them.
Yes, all published prices include VAT. They're a guide and may vary after the assessment, but we'll always tell you the final price before we start.
Yes. You can give an amount, a treatment or a pack. Cards are valid for 6 months and the person who receives it can choose the treatment later.
